title: UIDL Node
description: A node in the UIDL document tree. Mirrors the reference runtime's NodeSchema: `type`-driven, strict about id/type, permissive about the rest. The behaviour of bindings/events/visibility/repeat is described by the semantics docs and validated by the focused schemas below (expression/binding/action), not re-enforced here.

style.description: Presentation overrides for this node; meaning defined by the renderer (see semantics/style.md).

bindings.description: Map of prop name to a binding/expression node resolved at render time. Values are accepted permissively here; the strict contract is expression.schema.json / binding.schema.json.

events.description: Map of event name to an action list (see semantics/events.md). Accepts the runtime's full action vocabulary; the focused action.schema.json stays strict.

visibility.description: Visibility rule: a condition expression plus optional breakpoints.

repeat.description: Repeater: `dataSource` (array of rows or a binding path, see semantics/queries.md), item name, index flag.

responsive.description: DEPRECATED in the runtime; preserved for backward compatibility. Prefer style values.
